items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...And Dude was playing trumpet with him... [INTERVIEWEE] Joe Avery. Oh, Joe Avery.

ctx.x: Forty-five. Oh, no. I wasn't there. And Dude was playing trumpet with him, Foster and Brother. And Dude would take down, but the clarinet would, I mean the saxophone would carry the melody and the trombone would still play tailgate. And then Dude would come back. Who was on trombone?
